title: 第一千六百二十七章 决战北冥四第一千六百二十六章 决战北冥三
content_zh:
正当刘长旭与大罗初期雪鹿隔着护岛大阵激烈交锋之时，鲲鹏妖帝的攻势也越发猛烈。
北冥仙帝为了保存实力，以应对即将到来的另外两位妖族准帝，一旦仙力消耗过大，便躲入护岛大阵内，依仗护岛大阵与鲲鹏妖帝纠缠。
只是鲲鹏妖帝的攻势太猛，每一击都能给护岛大阵造成不小的损伤。
虽然护岛大阵短时间内还能支撑，但是，护岛大阵陷落那是早晚的事，唯一的差别是时间长短的问题。
这个结果，岛上很多人族强者都明白，不过，北冥仙帝没有发布谕旨，众人心中再急也没有任何办法，只能在惶恐不安中等待。
而与岛上绝大多数人族修士相比，刘长旭即便面对大罗初期雪鹿的重点针对，内心仍然能够保持平静。
此时的刘长旭已然与过去不同，掌握一成空间大道法则的他，即便不是大罗初期雪鹿的对手，但是逃走还是很有把握的。
除非鲲鹏妖帝，或者其它妖族准帝亲自出手对付他，但是，这个可能性很小。
不过为了在逃走时能保持充足的仙力，刘长旭对大罗初期雪鹿的反击一直未出全力。
由于人族一方有北冥仙帝的牵制，和护岛大阵存在，虽然妖族的实力占优，但始终未能攻破护岛大阵，双方一直处于相持状态。
刘长旭一边与掌控大道法则的大罗初期雪鹿耐心周旋，一边借着生死搏杀的契机，静心揣摩、参悟空间大道法则，反复打磨空间大道法则的运用之法。
这头大罗初期雪鹿虽然掌握的是冰属性大道法则，但是它每次借助冰属性大道法则之力展开攻击时，仍然大大开阔了刘长旭对大道法则的理解。
而大罗初期雪鹿的威胁下，也进一步促使刘长旭不得不强化对空间大道法则的参悟和运用。
刘长旭每一次施展空间大道法则仙术，都在亲身验证空间大道法则的奥妙，这比静坐苦修效果要好上很多。
双方厮杀越久越激烈，他对空间大道的领悟便愈发深刻，不仅空间之壁、空间挪移、空间之刃等空间攻防仙术更加精妙，他对空间大道法则的领悟也在一点一点提升。
这种提升的速度虽然不快，但也在逐步提升刘长旭的实力。
对面的大罗初期雪鹿，很快便察觉到了情况不对，那个杀死他血脉后裔的人族强者竟然越来越难对付，从只能在它的攻击下狼狈躲闪，到能够从容反击，这让它越发急躁。
而与大罗初期雪鹿相比，刘长旭则越打越顺，空间大道法则的领悟程度从一成，到一成一，一成二，……一成九，最后达到两成。
可不要小瞧这看似不起眼的提升，空间大道法则每一次微小的提升的，最终都会反馈到他的战力上，也让他对接下来危局更有信心。
周围众多人族强者眼见刘长旭一个太乙金仙竟能与大罗初期的雪鹿打得有来有往，受到极大震撼，战斗意志得到极大的加强，接连打退了妖族的多次猛扑，给妖族带来了极大杀伤。

然而，无论刘长旭，以及人族修士们多么努力，最终也未能改变失败的命运。
第三日下午，刘长旭还在与那头大罗初期雪鹿激战。
而连续三日的生死相搏，使得他的实力于厮杀之中突飞猛进，空间大道法则已然参悟两成三，火属性大道更是悟得半成火候，正式踏入大道法则门槛，综合战力较之开战前暴涨一倍有余，这让他对应对接下来的危局，底气愈发充足。
可正当他酝酿新的攻势时，遥远海天尽头骤然出现两股令他心悸的气息，紧接着，两道无边庞大的妖影撕裂云海，瞬息横渡亿万里虚空，出现在鲲鹏妖帝身不远处。
还在战斗的人妖两族强者，见到突然而至的这两道身影，身形纷纷极速后退，唯恐成了那被殃及的池鱼。
果然，众人尚未来得及分辨两道妖影的真身，两股准帝层次的无上仙术便已然催动，毁天灭地的攻势轰然爆发。
刺目到极致的一青一白两道神光瞬间席卷整片北冥海域，天光、海水、云雾尽数被这片恐怖光芒吞没，然后，狠狠撞在护岛大阵的光幕之上。
轰隆——！
毁天灭地的巨响层层叠叠炸开，护岛大阵的光芒以肉眼可见的速度大片黯淡、蛛网般的裂痕飞速向四面八方蔓延。
刺骨的大道寒意透过缝隙涌入岛内，不少修为低微的修士只稍稍触及一丝寒气，肉身便瞬间凝结成剔透冰雕，生机刹那断绝。
与刘长旭缠斗数日的大罗初期雪鹿借此良机，对刘长旭发动了最猛烈的攻势。
无数散发着刺骨寒意的冰矛，趁大阵防御灵光被妖帝打破的间隙，朝着刘长旭疯狂轰杀而来。
刘长旭心弦紧绷，体内仙力奔腾翻涌，道道宛若白莲的空间光壁层层叠叠在身前接连成型，死死阻拦大罗初期雪鹿倾泻而来的无尽冰矛。
这白莲状空间之壁是刘长旭借三日鏖战最新领悟的防御仙术，纯粹由空间大道法则凝练而成，虚实相生，防御威能远超以往单层空间壁垒，刘长旭将其命名为太虚莲壁。
冰矛呼啸着不停砸落，惊天动地轰鸣声连绵响起，不断有晶莹莲瓣在碰撞中罹灭，恐怖的能量余波席卷四方。
不过，在刘长旭强大仙力的支撑下，罹灭消失的莲瓣很快再次凝聚，重新挡在刘长旭身前。
就这样，刘长旭凭借太虚莲壁这一强大的防御仙术，硬生生扛下大罗初期雪鹿一波又一波狂暴攻势。
刘长旭在抵挡大罗初期雪鹿攻击之时，也在不停观察远处，北冥仙帝与那三位妖族准帝的战斗，心中默默思考何事撤退的问题。
这时，刘长旭也已然认出了新来的那两位妖族准帝，一头白色巨龙，一只青色鸾鸟。
而在三位妖族准帝的围攻下，护岛大阵很快变得摇摇欲坠，随时都有陷落的可能！
content_en:
Just as Liu Changxu and Daluo's early Xuelu were having a fierce confrontation across the island protection formation, Demon Emperor Kunpeng's offensive became more and more fierce.
In order to preserve his strength to deal with the coming of the other two demon quasi-emperors, Immortal Emperor Beiming hid in the island-protecting formation once his immortal power was too much, relying on the island-protecting formation to entangle Demon Emperor Kunpeng.
It's just that Kunpeng Demon Emperor's offensive is too fierce, and every blow can cause considerable damage to the island defense formation.
Although the island-protecting formation can still hold up in a short period of time, it will be a matter of time before the island-protecting formation falls. The only difference is the length of time.
Many powerful human beings on the island understood this result. However, Immortal Emperor Beiming did not issue an edict. No matter how anxious everyone was, they had no choice but to wait in panic.
Compared with the vast majority of human monks on the island, Liu Changxu was still able to remain calm even when faced with the key targets of Snow Deer in the early days of Da Luo.
At this time, Liu Changxu was different from the past. He had mastered the 10% Space Avenue Law. Even if he was not the opponent of Xuelu in the early days of Da Luo, he was still very confident in escaping.
Unless Demon Emperor Kunpeng or other demon clan quasi-emperors personally deal with him, however, this possibility is very small.
However, in order to maintain sufficient immortal power when escaping, Liu Changxu never used his full strength to counterattack Daluo's early Snow Deer.
Due to the restraint of the Beiming Immortal Emperor on the human side and the existence of the island-protecting formation, although the demon race has the advantage, they have never been able to break through the island-protecting formation, and the two sides have been in a stalemate.
While Liu Changxu was patiently dealing with Xuelu, who controlled the Great Law of Space in the early stage of Da Luo, he took advantage of the opportunity of life and death fighting to ponder and understand the Law of Space, and repeatedly polished the application of the Law of Space.
Although this snow deer in the early stage of Da Luo mastered the Great Law of the Ice Attribute, every time it launched an attack with the power of the Great Law of the Ice Attribute, it still greatly broadened Liu Changxu's understanding of the Great Law.
In the early days of Da Luo, the threat of Snow Deer also further prompted Liu Changxu to strengthen his understanding and application of the laws of space.
Every time Liu Changxu performs the magic of Space Avenue Law, he is personally verifying the mystery of Space Avenue Law. This is much better than sitting in meditation and practicing hard.
The longer and more intense the fight between the two sides became, the more profound his understanding of the Space Avenue became. Not only did the spatial offensive and defensive magic techniques such as Space Wall, Space Movement, and Space Blade become more sophisticated, but his understanding of the laws of the Space Avenue also improved little by little.
Although the speed of this improvement is not fast, it is also gradually improving Liu Changxu's strength.
The Snow Deer in the early stage of Daluo on the opposite side soon realized that something was wrong. The strong human race who killed his descendant was becoming more and more difficult to deal with. From being able to dodge under its attacks to being able to counterattack calmly, it became more and more impatient.
Compared with Xue Lu in the early stage of Da Luo, Liu Changxu became more and more successful, and his understanding of the law of space avenue increased from 10%, to 10%, 12%,... 19%, and finally reached 20%.
Don't underestimate this seemingly inconspicuous improvement. Every small improvement in the Space Avenue Law will eventually be fed back to his combat power, making him more confident in the upcoming crisis.
Many strong human beings around saw Liu Changxu, a Taiyi Golden Immortal, fighting against the Snow Deer in the early stage of Daluo. They were greatly shocked, and their fighting will was greatly strengthened. They repelled many attacks from the demon clan, causing great damage to the demon clan.
However, no matter how hard Liu Changxu and the human monks tried, they could not change the fate of failure in the end.
On the afternoon of the third day, Liu Changxu was still fighting fiercely with the early stage snow deer.
Three consecutive days of life-and-death battles made his strength improve by leaps and bounds during the fighting. He had already comprehended 23% of the laws of the Space Avenue, and half of the fire attribute laws. He officially entered the threshold of the Avenue of Laws, and his overall combat power more than doubled compared to before the war started.This will give him more confidence to deal with the upcoming crisis.
But just as he was preparing a new offensive, two auras that made his heart palpitate suddenly appeared at the end of the distant sea and sky. Immediately afterwards, two boundless and huge demonic figures tore through the sea of ​​clouds, crossed hundreds of millions of miles of void in an instant, and appeared not far from Demon Emperor Kunpeng.
The strong men of the human and demon tribes who were still fighting, when they saw the two figures that suddenly arrived, they retreated quickly, fearing that they would become the fish in the pond.
Sure enough, before everyone had time to distinguish the true form of the two demonic figures, two quasi-emperor-level supreme celestial arts were activated, and a heaven-destroying and earth-destroying offensive erupted.
Two extremely dazzling divine lights, one green and one white, instantly swept across the entire Beiming Sea. The skylight, seawater, and clouds were all swallowed up by this terrifying light, and then, they hit the light curtain of the island protection formation.
Boom——!
Loud noises that destroyed the world exploded one after another, and the light of the island-protecting formation spread rapidly in all directions with large, dim, spiderweb-like cracks visible to the naked eye.
The biting cold of the avenue poured into the island through the gaps. Many monks with low cultivation level only touched a little bit of the cold air, and their bodies instantly condensed into crystal clear ice sculptures, and their vitality was cut off in an instant.
Xuelu, who had been fighting with Liu Changxu for several days, took this opportunity to launch the most violent offensive against Liu Changxu.
Countless ice spears exuding biting coldness took advantage of the gap between the defensive aura of the formation and the demon emperor to blast towards Liu Changxu crazily.
Liu Changxu's heartstrings were tense, and the immortal power in his body was surging. The spatial light walls like white lotus stacked one after another in front of him, blocking the endless ice spears pouring from the Snow Deer in the early stage of Da Luo.
This white lotus-shaped space wall is the latest defensive magic that Liu Changxu has learned through three days of fierce battles. It is purely condensed by the laws of the great avenue of space. The virtual and the real complement each other, and its defensive power far exceeds the previous single-layer space barriers. Liu Changxu named it Taixu Lotus Wall.
The ice spears roared and fell continuously, and earth-shattering roars sounded continuously. Crystal lotus petals were constantly being destroyed in the collision, and the terrifying energy aftermath swept across all directions.
However, with the support of Liu Changxu's powerful immortal power, the destroyed lotus petals quickly condensed again and stood in front of Liu Changxu again.
In this way, Liu Changxu relied on the powerful defensive magic of Taixu Lotus Wall to withstand waves of violent attacks from Snow Deer in the early stage of Da Luo.
When Liu Changxu was resisting the attack of Snow Deer in the early stage of Daluo, he was also constantly observing the battle in the distance between the Beiming Immortal Emperor and the three demon quasi-emperors, silently thinking about why to retreat.
At this time, Liu Changxu had already recognized the two new demon clan quasi-emperors, a white giant dragon and a blue luan bird.
Under the siege of the three demon clan quasi-emperors, the island defense formation quickly became shaky, and there was a possibility of falling at any time!
